messages:
leo-eng: kicking off the v2 gateway flip at the start of the maintenance window. target: route weight migration from v1 -> v2 in stages. change window 02:00-03:00 UTC.
emma: copying the checklist: 1) pin headers for critical customers, 2) run canary 10% for 15m, 3) watch p50/p95, 4) increase to 50% then 100% if healthy.
raj: note — client SDKs that rely on `X-Model-Behavior` will need the compatibility header. we'll send a patch to client-sdk with opt-in pinning.
sarah-product: we already added messaging in the release notes draft: "breaking changes: none expected, opt-in v2 behavior behind header" will publish after deploy if everything green.
client-sdk-bot: automatic PR created: redwood/client-sdk#412 — adds `X-Redwood-Version: v1|v2` header support and feature flag to default to v1 for 7 days. link: https://github.com/redwood/client-sdk/pull/412 :shipit:
leo-eng: deploy-bot, start canary deploy for gateway-route `api-text` -> v2 at 02:05 UTC, 10% traffic.
deploy-bot: [deploy] canary started by leo-eng — gateway-route api-text -> v2, weight=10%, commit=aa1f3b4, canary window 15m.
olga-sre: I'll watch infra metrics and traces (app, infra, edge). set alerts for error-rate >0.5% or latency p95 increase >20%.
emma: quick pin plan for top 5 customers: add header `X-Redwood-Version: v1` to keep them on v1 until we verify compat. I'll put the curl snippet in the ops runbook.
emma: ```curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Redwood-Version: v1" \  https://api.redwood.ai/v2/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'```
raj: reminder: the gateway respects header first, then sticky client session. so pinning header overrides traffic routing. good for staged migration.
deploy-bot: canary update — 10% -> 50% at 02:22 UTC, no errors observed, avg latency stable.
leo-eng: increasing to 50% now. If no regressions in 10m we plan full shift.
olga-sre: saw a small spike in tokenization errors from a downstream tokenizer service at 02:28, error-rate peaked 0.4% then back down after 80s. keeping an eye.
emma: flagging customer-327 and customer-412 for immediate pin if they report issues.
client-sdk-bot: Customer telemetry shows 3 clients without new SDK — they will keep calling without the header. we should send opt-in change notes to them.
sarah-product: messaging queued to customers and status page to mention opt-in header and fallback behavior.
leo-eng: proceed to 100% at 02:35 if no alerts.
deploy-bot: progressing to 100% at 02:36 UTC — final weight applied.
olga-sre: alert at 02:39 UTC — p95 latency +35% and error-rate 1.2% in region eu-west-1. triggering rollback runbook. :warning:
leo-eng: initiating rollback to v1 route weights. rolling back now.
deploy-bot: rollback started by leo-eng — target: route weight api-text -> v1 = 100%, reason: latency spike in eu-west-1. rollback ETA ~90s.
olga-sre: confirming rollback metrics stable. p95 returning to baseline.
emma: calling out to support to pin customer-327 and 412 while we investigate.
raj: root cause hypothesis: runtime quantization path for a specific batch size in eu-west hardware combo. logging traces sent to #eng-runtime.
leo-eng: can we do a targeted variant of v2 that disables that quant path? quick hotfix: `v2-safe` build without qkernels.
deploy-bot: hotfix build v2-safe queued. canary to 5% after smoke tests pass.
client-sdk-bot: recommend we keep default SDK behavior = v1 until v2-safe is validated across regions.
sarah-product: updating release notes: add known issue and recommended pin header for impacted customers. will post a follow-up in #customers.
leo-eng: summary — rollback complete at 02:41. v1 100% restored. hotfix PR in progress for v2-safe. we'll schedule a limited region reattempt tomorrow in a smaller change window. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
